part1_desc: 第 1–24 步：跟站长学接订购电话，听懂规格。
part2_desc: 第 25–36 步：自己接新的电话，记下订单。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：听懂比较级/最高级关键词、理解电话用语。Unit 3 Computers 主题。

steps.title: 订购热线
steps.teach_html:
科技特别节目火了！很多听众打电话来订购节目里介绍的电脑。

站长开了条订购热线，让你来接电话。你的任务：听懂客人要哪台电脑，记下规格（配置），别记错了。

电话里客人会说“要更快的那台”“最便宜的那台”，比较级和最高级都会出现，耳朵要竖起来。

steps.title: 规格词
steps.teach_html:
先学生词，电话里会听到：

  • memory（内存）：电脑记东西的能力，越大越好
  • screen size（屏幕尺寸）：屏幕多大
  • order（订购）：我要买
  • delivery（送货）：送到家里

例句：I want to order the computer with bigger memory.（我想订内存更大的那台电脑。）

steps.title: 听电话的三步
steps.teach_html:
接电话记住三步：

  • 第一步：听关键词——客人说 faster（更快）、cheapest（最便宜），抓住这些词。
  • 第二步：对资料——把听到的词和电脑资料对上，是哪一台。
  • 第三步：再确认——复述一遍：“您要的是……对吗？”

电话里听不清很正常，关键是抓住比较级/最高级那个词。

steps.title: 电话用语
steps.teach_html:
电话里常用的句子：

  • I'd like the cheaper one.（我想要便宜的那台。）
  • Which one is the fastest?（哪台最快？）
  • Is this one better than that one?（这台比那台好吗？）

one 在这里指“那台（电脑）”，避免重复说 computer。

steps.title: 听第一通电话
steps.reading:
Phone call 1:
Customer: Hello! I'd like to order a computer.
You: Sure! We have two: Model S (slow, 3000 yuan) and Model F (faster, 4500 yuan).
Customer: I want the faster one. Is it more expensive?
You: Yes, it's more expensive than Model S.
Customer: OK, I'll take the faster one. Please deliver it tomorrow.
steps.teach_html:
上面是第一通电话的记录。跟着读一遍，注意这两个地方：

  • 客人说 the faster one（更快的那台）→ 要的是 Model F
  • 你回答 more expensive than（比……更贵）→ 比较级 + than

关键词 faster 决定了客人要哪台。

steps.title: the one 指哪个
steps.teach_html:
the faster one = 更快的那台电脑，the cheapest one = 最便宜的那台电脑。

one 代替前面说过的 computer，说话更简短。

  • I'd like the cheaper one.（我想要便宜的那台。）
  • Which is the best one?（哪台是最好的？）

steps.title: 听第二通电话
steps.reading:
Phone call 2:
Customer: Which computer is the cheapest?
You: Model S is the cheapest. It's 3000 yuan.
Customer: Is it slower than Model F?
You: Yes, it's slower, but it's good for homework.
Customer: Great, I'll take the cheapest one.
steps.teach_html:
第二通电话：客人问 the cheapest（最便宜的）→ 要的是 Model S。

客人还确认：Is it slower than Model F?（它比 F 慢吗？）你回答 slower（更慢）。

听电话时，the cheapest 这种最高级一出来，就知道客人要哪台了。

steps.title: 准备接电话
steps.teach_html:
复习一下电话里要听的：

  • the faster one / the cheaper one（更快/便宜的那台）
  • the cheapest / the fastest（最便宜/最快的）
  • more expensive than（比……更贵）
  • one = 那台（电脑）

下面站长放电话录音（看文字记录），你来接。

steps.title: 电话记录
steps.reading:
Phone call 1:
Customer: Hello! I'd like to order a computer.
You: Sure! We have two: Model S (slow, 3000 yuan) and Model F (faster, 4500 yuan).
Customer: I want the faster one. Is it more expensive?
You: Yes, it's more expensive than Model S.
Customer: OK, I'll take the faster one. Please deliver it tomorrow.
steps.teach_html: 第一通电话的记录在上面。客人要的是哪台？对照着答题。

steps.title: 客人要哪台
steps.reading:
Phone call 1:
Customer: Hello! I'd like to order a computer.
You: Sure! We have two: Model S (slow, 3000 yuan) and Model F (faster, 4500 yuan).
Customer: I want the faster one. Is it more expensive?
You: Yes, it's more expensive than Model S.
Customer: OK, I'll take the faster one. Please deliver it tomorrow.
steps.stem: 客人说 "the faster one"，他要的是哪台？
steps.help: faster 是哪台的特征？看资料。
steps.explain: Model F 是 faster 的那台。

wrong_feedback.A: Model S 是 slow 的那台。客人说的是 faster，再看一遍。
wrong_feedback.C: Model X 没在这通电话里出现。再看一遍。
wrong_feedback.D: Model Z 没在这通电话里出现。再看一遍。

steps.title: 贵多少
steps.reading:
Phone call 1:
Customer: Hello! I'd like to order a computer.
You: Sure! We have two: Model S (slow, 3000 yuan) and Model F (faster, 4500 yuan).
Customer: I want the faster one. Is it more expensive?
You: Yes, it's more expensive than Model S.
Customer: OK, I'll take the faster one. Please deliver it tomorrow.
steps.stem: Model F 和 Model S 比，哪个说法对？
options: Model F is cheaper than Model S.
Model S is more expensive than Model F.
Model F is more expensive than Model S.
steps.help: 电话里你是怎么回答的？
steps.explain: Model F is more expensive than Model S.

wrong_feedback.A: 电话里客人问 Is it more expensive，你回答 Yes。再看一遍。
wrong_feedback.B: 主语反了，是 F 比 S 贵，不是 S 比 F 贵。
wrong_feedback.D: 价格不一样：4500 和 3000。再看一遍。

steps.title: 第二通电话
steps.reading:
Phone call 2:
Customer: Which computer is the cheapest?
You: Model S is the cheapest. It's 3000 yuan.
Customer: Is it slower than Model F?
You: Yes, it's slower, but it's good for homework.
Customer: Great, I'll take the cheapest one.
steps.stem: 客人问 "the cheapest"，他要的是哪台？

wrong_feedback.A: Model F 是 4500 元，不是 cheapest。再看一遍。
wrong_feedback.B: 客人只要一台。再看一遍。
wrong_feedback.C: 客人问得很清楚：the cheapest。再看一遍。

steps.title: slower 的意思
steps.reading:
Phone call 2:
Customer: Which computer is the cheapest?
You: Model S is the cheapest. It's 3000 yuan.
Customer: Is it slower than Model F?
You: Yes, it's slower, but it's good for homework.
Customer: Great, I'll take the cheapest one.
steps.stem: 你说 Model S "slower"，意思是？
steps.help: slow 的比较级是什么意思？

wrong_feedback.A: faster 才是更快。slower 是 slow 的比较级，再想想。
wrong_feedback.C: slowest 才是最慢。这里是 slower，再想想。
wrong_feedback.D: slower 是比较，有快慢之分。再想想。

steps.title: one 指什么
steps.reading:
Phone call 1:
Customer: Hello! I'd like to order a computer.
You: Sure! We have two: Model S (slow, 3000 yuan) and Model F (faster, 4500 yuan).
Customer: I want the faster one. Is it more expensive?
You: Yes, it's more expensive than Model S.
Customer: OK, I'll take the faster one. Please deliver it tomorrow.
steps.stem: "the faster one" 里，one 指什么？
steps.help: 不对。上下文在说买什么？

wrong_feedback.A: 电话是 phone，one 指的是要买的东西。再想想。
wrong_feedback.B: one 不是指人。再想想上下文。

steps.title: delivery 的意思
steps.reading:
Phone call 1:
Customer: Hello! I'd like to order a computer.
You: Sure! We have two: Model S (slow, 3000 yuan) and Model F (faster, 4500 yuan).
Customer: I want the faster one. Is it more expensive?
You: Yes, it's more expensive than Model S.
Customer: OK, I'll take the faster one. Please deliver it tomorrow.
steps.stem: "Please deliver it tomorrow" 里，deliver 是什么意思？

wrong_feedback.A: 修理是 repair。deliver 是第 2 步学的词，再想想。
wrong_feedback.B: 退货是 return。deliver 不是这个意思。
wrong_feedback.C: 看看是 look。deliver 是送货。

steps.title: 客人确认什么
steps.reading:
Phone call 2:
Customer: Which computer is the cheapest?
You: Model S is the cheapest. It's 3000 yuan.
Customer: Is it slower than Model F?
You: Yes, it's slower, but it's good for homework.
Customer: Great, I'll take the cheapest one.
steps.stem: 客人问 "Is it slower than Model F?"，他在确认什么？
options: S 和 F 一样吗
steps.explain: 确认 S 是不是比 F 慢。

wrong_feedback.B: slower 是更慢，不是更快。再看一遍问句。
wrong_feedback.C: 问句里有 slower than，是比快慢，不是问一样。
wrong_feedback.D: 问句没问价格，问的是慢不慢。

steps.title: 综合理解
steps.stem: 两通电话里，客人都买了电脑。第一通买的是更快的，第二通买的是最便宜的。说法对吗？
options: 错，第一通买的是最便宜的
错，第二通买的是更快的
steps.help: 第一通 faster→F，第二通 cheapest→S。

wrong_feedback.B: 第一通客人说 the faster one，是 F。再看第一通记录。
wrong_feedback.C: 第二通客人说 the cheapest one，是 S。再看第二通记录。
wrong_feedback.D: 两通最后都说 I'll take。再看结尾。

steps.title: 写出 faster 的原级
steps.stem: faster 是比较级，它的原级是什么？

steps.title: 写出 cheapest 的原级
steps.stem: cheapest 是最高级，它的原级是什么？

common_errors.say: 要的是原级 cheap，不是比较级。

steps.title: 补全句子
steps.stem: 客人要 Model F，你复述：You want ______ one.（更快的那台）

steps.title: 小结一下
steps.teach_html:
电话小结：

  • 听关键词：faster、cheapest、more expensive
  • one = 那台（电脑）
  • the faster one（更快的那台）、the cheapest one（最便宜的那台）
  • 复述确认：You want the faster one, right?

下面新的电话，你自己接。

steps.title: memory 的意思
steps.stem: memory 在电脑语境里是什么意思？

wrong_feedback.A: 记忆力是人的，电脑的 memory 是内存。再想想第 2 步。

steps.title: 写确认句
steps.stem: 客人要最便宜的那台，你复述：You want ______ one.

common_errors.say: 最便宜用最高级 the cheapest。

steps.title: 写比较句
steps.stem: 客人问：Is Model F better? 你回答：Yes, it's ______ than Model S.（更好）

common_errors.say: good 的比较级是 better，特殊记。

steps.title: 新的电话
steps.reading:
Phone call 3:
Customer: Hello! Which laptop is the lightest?
You: Model L is the lightest. It's 2 kg.
Customer: Is it more expensive than Model H?
You: Yes, it's more expensive, but it has bigger memory.
Customer: OK. I'd like the lightest one, please.

Phone call 4:
Customer: I need a computer for games. Which is the best one?
You: Model G is the best one for games. It's the fastest.
Customer: Is it the most expensive?
You: Yes, but it's worth it.
Customer: Fine, I'll take the best one.
steps.teach_html:
又有两通电话（上面）。这次你自己听、自己记，站长不帮忙。

抓住关键词：the lightest、more expensive、the best one、the fastest。

steps.title: 第三通：要哪台
steps.reading:
Phone call 3:
Customer: Hello! Which laptop is the lightest?
You: Model L is the lightest. It's 2 kg.
Customer: Is it more expensive than Model H?
You: Yes, it's more expensive, but it has bigger memory.
Customer: OK. I'd like the lightest one, please.
steps.stem: 客人说 "the lightest one"，他要的是？

wrong_feedback.A: Model H 没说是最轻的。再看一遍。
wrong_feedback.B: 客人只要一台。再看一遍。
wrong_feedback.C: 客人说得很清楚。再看一遍。

steps.title: 第三通：贵不贵
steps.reading:
Phone call 3:
Customer: Hello! Which laptop is the lightest?
You: Model L is the lightest. It's 2 kg.
Customer: Is it more expensive than Model H?
You: Yes, it's more expensive, but it has bigger memory.
Customer: OK. I'd like the lightest one, please.
steps.stem: Model L 和 Model H 比，哪个说法对？
options: Model L is cheaper than Model H.
Model H is more expensive than Model L.
Model L is more expensive than Model H.
steps.explain: Model L is more expensive than Model H.

wrong_feedback.A: 你回答的是 Yes, it's more expensive。再看一遍。
wrong_feedback.B: 主语反了，是 L 比 H 贵。

steps.title: 第四通：要哪台
steps.reading:
Phone call 4:
Customer: I need a computer for games. Which is the best one?
You: Model G is the best one for games. It's the fastest.
Customer: Is it the most expensive?
You: Yes, but it's worth it.
Customer: Fine, I'll take the best one.
steps.stem: 客人说 "the best one"，他要的是？
steps.explain: Model G 是 the best one。

wrong_feedback.B: 你明确说了 Model G is the best one。再看一遍。
wrong_feedback.D: 客人要的是 best，不是 cheapest。再看一遍。

steps.title: 第四通：最贵吗
steps.reading:
Phone call 4:
Customer: I need a computer for games. Which is the best one?
You: Model G is the best one for games. It's the fastest.
Customer: Is it the most expensive?
You: Yes, but it's worth it.
Customer: Fine, I'll take the best one.
steps.stem: 客人问 "Is it the most expensive?"，你的回答是？

wrong_feedback.A: 你回答的是 Yes。再看一遍。
wrong_feedback.D: 你直接回答了 Yes。再看一遍。

steps.title: 写出 lightest 的原级
steps.stem: lightest 的原级是什么？

common_errors.say: 要原级 light，不是比较级。

steps.title: 补全问句
steps.stem: Which laptop is ______?（最轻的）

steps.title: 写回答
steps.stem: Is Model L more expensive? 回答：Yes, it's ______ than Model H.（更贵）

steps.title: 写推荐
steps.stem: 用最高级写：G 是打游戏最好的电脑。
steps.answer_text: Model G is the best one for games.

answers: model g is the best one for games
g is the best one for games
model g is the best for games

steps.help: G is + the best one + for games。
steps.explain: Model G is the best one for games.

common_errors.say: 最好用最高级 the best。

steps.title: bigger memory
steps.reading:
Phone call 3:
Customer: Hello! Which laptop is the lightest?
You: Model L is the lightest. It's 2 kg.
Customer: Is it more expensive than Model H?
You: Yes, it's more expensive, but it has bigger memory.
Customer: OK. I'd like the lightest one, please.
steps.stem: "it has bigger memory" 是什么意思？

wrong_feedback.B: bigger 是更大，不是更小。再想想。
wrong_feedback.C: bigger 是比较，有大小之分。再想想。

steps.title: worth it 的意思
steps.reading:
Phone call 4:
Customer: I need a computer for games. Which is the best one?
You: Model G is the best one for games. It's the fastest.
Customer: Is it the most expensive?
You: Yes, but it's worth it.
Customer: Fine, I'll take the best one.
steps.stem: "it's worth it" 大概是什么意思？
steps.help: 客人最后买了，说明觉得？

wrong_feedback.A: 客人最后说 Fine, I'll take，说明觉得值得。再想想。
wrong_feedback.C: 贵不贵和值不值是两回事。再想想。

steps.title: 节目预告
steps.teach_html:
订购热线今天接到好几单，都没记错。站长夸你耳朵灵。

下期：站长要给供应商写邮件，对比几款显示器。写邮件和打电话不一样，要把比较级写清楚。准备一下。
